architecture: Ordered finite regex question-intent classifier; emergency and clinical guards first; scored topic selection; explicit topic plus requested facet; exact reference forms alone may use prior topic. Missing facets never fall through to generic topic text. Definition/explanation uses the entry response, with a specific sleep explanation override. Competing topics or requested facets clarify.
coverageLimit: Classification does not imply an authored answer for every topic/facet. No general food-frequency targets or cooking durations were added.
